She otherwise does not do anything in the kitchen then why in front of you try to be busy. A couple of weeks back when she used to stand in the kitchen I did tell instead of standing you can do some small jobs in the kitchen and learn a few things but she never did anything. I never bothered after that it's her wish. No body has told her to do anything. Today also since morning she did not pick those veggies then why in front of you. She can attend to Rudra when he is at home.
